site.sitedescription: Lake with minor inflow and outflow stream. Trees and arable land west of the lake; blanket peat and abandoned farmland east of the lake. Alnus glutinosa and Salix cinerea fringe the lake in the wettest areas, with Populus tremula and Sorbus aucuparia on steeper rocky slopes. Catchment was intesnsively cultivated in the past.
